explanation: data/hypomap/ is new analysis input: provenance.json pins the CELLxGENE mouse HypoMap H5AD (dataset version 2408fb24, SHA-256 1771194977...), the study card and two MGI reports, and records the new release hypomap-atlas-2026-11-26 with the never-published 2026-11-05 release it supersedes. The README documents the metric definitions (raw/X count >= 1; ln(1 + 10,000 x count / cell raw/X total)) and why the 21,421 non-primary Mousebrainorg10x cells are not double-counted. No existing evidence ledger changed.
